purpose: Classify every reviewed physical R2 net before copper is drawn, so an automatic helper can never route RF, USB, power, i8080, clocks, safety or analogue nets as ordinary signals.

stackup_binding.exact_trace_geometry_status: pending H6.0.4 digital/USB and H6.0.5 RF calculator binding

GROUND_REFERENCE.intent: Uninterrupted In1/In4 reference planes plus short, explicit local ground joins.

PRIMARY_POWER.intent: Source, pack, protected-system and externally powered paths sized from the reviewed current envelope.

POWER_BRANCH.intent: Regulated and switched load rails with local return and decoupling placement preserved.

SWITCHING_NODE.intent: Keep each converter hot loop compact and away from RF, clocks, audio and sense nodes.

RF_CONTROLLED.intent: Ten antenna feeds and every matching, sampling, Airband and receiver RF segment.

USB_DIFFERENTIAL.intent: All four USB 2.0 paths, routed as coupled pairs over a continuous reference.

DISPLAY_I8080.intent: Direct S3 i8080-8 data bus plus WR and D/C, kept local and reviewed as one skew group.

OSCILLATOR.intent: Short crystal and oscillator loops with no automatic vias or crossings.

CLOCKED_DIGITAL.intent: SDIO, SPI, I2S, M1 and other synchronous buses routed and reviewed as groups.

SAFETY_CONTROL.intent: Fault, kill, run-permit, watchdog, TX-evidence, PTT and power-enable paths remain visibly independent.

SERIAL_CONTROL.intent: I2C, UART, SWD and service/debug groups retain ownership and accessible branches.

ANALOG_AUDIO_SENSE.intent: Audio, detector, feedback, bias and measurement nodes avoid switching return currents.

GENERAL_CONTROL.intent: Only the residual low-rate digital controls may be proposed by an automatic routing helper.

automatic_helper.acceptance: No helper output is accepted until imported into KiCad, visually reviewed and passed by the native DRC.
